ns2:course.label: Intermediate Chinese II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of CHIN 203. Concentration on ability to engage in fluent discourse, on comprehensive grammatical knowledge, and on ability to read ordinary simple text in Chinese. Prerequisite: CHIN 203 or equivalent.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Prior knowledge of language requires a placement exam to be given. Call 244-1432 for date of exam and to register for the test.
